'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 2 Steve Baroni DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
